text_block_list.text:
I'm wandering the school grounds<n>when I bump
into Biwa Hayahide,<n>who looks quite ill.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haha... Not exactly. I have a slight<n>headache.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I checked the weather reports<n>thinking a change in
barometric<n>pressure triggered it, but there<n>haven't
been any major fluctuations<n>recently.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm experiencing fatigue and<n>intermittent pain as
well, so it's likely<n>a migraine, but I can't rule out
other<n>pathologies.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I compared my symptoms against<n>other illnesses to
be cautious, but the<n>more I think about it, the more
my<n>head hurts...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: You're overthinking again. Take a deep breath.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're right... I recall reading a study<n>that
mentioned the importance of<n>resting your nerves.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Ngh... I just can't seem to settle<n>down.

Biwa Hayahide's seems to really be<n>overthinking
her headache...
